name: Taiwan Mobile Co Ltd
summary: Taiwan Mobile Co., Ltd. is a major provider of wireless communication services, operating both within Taiwan and on an international scale. Its diverse operations are structured across four principal segments: Telecommunications, Retail, Cable Television, and various other ventures. Core offerings within its telecommunications arm include mobile, mobile data, and fixed-line connectivity solutions. In the retail sector, it engages in TV, online, and catalog shopping. Furthermore, it delivers pay television and high-speed cable broadband services. Beyond these, the company acts as an agency for travel, property insurance, and life insurance, and runs online music platforms. Its portfolio of value-added services encompasses video and music streaming, instant messaging, as well as smart home and Internet of Things (IoT) related solutions. The company's activities also extend to participating in Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects, managing call centers, engaging in telephony, making investments, operating retail outlets, and developing/designing mobile applications. Additionally, it is involved in the sale of mobile devices, accessories, digital games, and e-books. The company markets its wide array of products and services under the brand names Taiwan Mobile, TWM Broadband, and TWM Business Solution. Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1997, it remains headquartered there.
